mapper.select: SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post WHERE slug = #{slug}
SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post
SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, slug, author, category, image_url AS imageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, markdown_content AS markdownContent FROM blog_post ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_post (title, slug, author, category, image_url, created_at, markdown_content) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{author}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{markdownContent})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_post SET title = #{title}, slug = #{slug}, category = #{category}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, markdown_content = #{markdownContent}, author = #{author} WHERE id = #{id}
